svg.title: Monitored dynamics & emergent phases
svg.desc: Circuit with unitary evolution layers and local projective measurements, alongside a phase diagram separating entangling and disentangling dynamics at a measurement-induced critical point. Circuit: Fig. 1(a) from Qicheng Tang, W. Zhu, Measurement-induced phase transition: A case study in the nonintegrable model by density-matrix renormalization group calculations, Physical Review Research 2, 013022 (2020). https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevResearch.2.013022. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Circuit panel cropped from the original figure PDF, omitting the panel label and the separate phase diagram in panel (b). Combined with the phase diagram from Skinner et al. and converted to SVG with lettering preserved as paths. Phase diagram: Fig. 1 from Brian Skinner, Jonathan Ruhman, Adam Nahum, Measurement-Induced Phase Transitions in the Dynamics of Entanglement, Physical Review X 9, 031009 (2019). https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevX.9.031009. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Original phase diagram combined with the circuit panel from Tang and Zhu; converted to SVG with lettering preserved as paths.
